terra.problem: “Israel doesn't waste a second” adds timing the text does not give.

“Nothing left in it” overstates the devastation. The passage mentions desert jackals and ruins.
The claim about where jackals do not settle is not supported by the passage.
“Nobody is holding anything down up there” adds a detail about the mountains that the text does not give.
